selection_rule: Identity: the existing, already-frozen 35-symbol PIV universe (talonx_piv.config.DEFAULT_UNIVERSE), unchanged from Task 64. No new selection or filtering was applied for Task 65.
reasoning: The runtime implementation (talonx_piv/session_runner.py) obtains live data via Alpaca's stateless, batched multi-symbol REST endpoints (/v2/stocks/bars/latest and /v2/stocks/trades/latest), not a persistent WebSocket stream subscription.
Alpaca's documented simultaneous-symbol subscription limits apply to the streaming WebSocket API tiers (a persistent per-connection subscription count), which this design does not use at all.

A single batched REST call requesting all 35 symbols at once (feed=iex, explicit, no fallback) returned HTTP 200 with all 35 symbols present in the response and zero missing symbols -- see iex_piv_feed_report.json for the raw evidence, captured live before market open on 2026-08-24.

Because one poll of the full universe costs exactly one HTTP request regardless of universe size, there is no provider- or runtime-imposed ceiling below 35 for this polling design. No PIV_TEST_UNIVERSE subset is required; the largest safe universe (all 35) is used, per the plan's preference for the largest safe universe over an arbitrarily small subset.
not_guessed: This conclusion is based on a live HTTP request against the real Alpaca IEX data endpoint (see iex_piv_feed_report.json), not an assumption about API limits.
no_optimization: This selection was made before observing any market outcome for today's session and is independent of price action -- it is the pre-existing frozen universe, not a symbol-picking exercise.
